trends.headline_stat_context: of Americans are now fibermaxxing, counting grams like macros

discourse.the_answer: Women 25-40 have shifted from subtractive to additive nutrition framing, with fiber replacing protein as the primary tracked macro.
discourse.summary: Two years of protein fortification across categories (coffee, chips, cereal) has produced visible fatigue and parody. The cohort now sets daily fiber targets (commonly 30g) and logs them in the same apps. A parallel, low-visibility conversation concerns eating on GLP-1 medication, where search volume far exceeds published content.

themes.setup: Chia, lentils and 30-plants-a-week challenges logged like macros.
Backlash and parody targeting protein-fortified coffee, chips and cereal.
Smaller plates, nausea workarounds and muscle-loss concern.
Vinegar before meals, post-dinner walks, avoiding naked carbs.
Flatbreads, ice cream and queso built on cottage cheese.
